summary: Tested new Budget Fiche modal, 'Aucune Prime' option, budget-preview/budget-override endpoints and informational days behavior. All 6 new pytest cases PASS (12/12 total across regression + fiche suite). Full frontend flow verified via Playwright: edit-line button opens fiche, live preview updates total, save persists with 'Ajusté' badge, reset clears it, CCQ hides RPDB/BONI/Assurance and shows CCQ note + Avantages CCQ, 'Aucune Prime' appears in both fiche and employee-form selects.

issues: Hire date & birth date inputs use browser native date picker (type=date) instead of shadcn calendar component — carry-over from prev iterations.

critical_code_review_comments: compute_section: override 'boni'/'reer'/'assurance' values are cast via float(...) with no bounds — negative numbers would reduce totals. Consider max(0, ...).
BudgetFicheDialog seeds vacation_rate_pct from the *computed* line.vacation_rate, which is fine, but if the user leaves 'Augmentation (%)' empty it becomes 0 (Number('') === 0). Small UX gotcha.
budget-preview endpoint does not validate that override keys are known (unknown keys silently ignored). Acceptable but worth an allowlist.
PUT /api/employees/{id}/budget-override with empty override + non-existent section is a no-op $unset returning success — harmless but could be documented.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_NoPrime employee inside test. Applied and cleared budget overrides on Isabelle Caron and a CCQ employee within test teardown. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fiche editor uses debounced (200ms) /budget-preview call — allow ~800-1000ms after typing before asserting fiche-total. Editing hire/birth dates still uses native <input type=date>. detail-tab-actuel/ca/revue switch which section is edited (aug=0 for actuel). All 8 seeded employees present; #5 Isabelle Caron is Régulier, #1-#4 are CCQ.
